{{Quote|Nem'ro really is full of surprises. I mean, for an underhanded, gluttonous, backstabbing slob, who'd have thought his palace could be so... clean.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:NP">{{TORcite|type=location|Nem'ro's Palace|Hutta}}</ref>}}
'''Nem'ro's Palace''', known locally as '''Nem'ro's Lotus of Victory''', was the base of operations for [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was located in the industrial town of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. It contained all of the usual amenities of a Hutt palace, including a cantina, at least two throne rooms, guest rooms, and a beast pit.

The palace had a reputation for being a common hangout for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and other disreputable criminals.
